assembly.why: observed: 18 pad-bearing part(s) on F and 0 on B, 1 reflow pass(es). every footprint BLOCK (#726): blocks sharing one reference are keyed with an ordinal suffix and counted separately. `pad_bearing` restricts that to blocks carrying at least one pad, and it is the count the populated-side verdict is taken from -- a zero-pad graphic on the back does not make a board double-sided.

blocks.name: ldo
blocks.note: brief power_chain: USB1 VBUS -> C1 -> U2 -> /+3.3V -> C3 -> U1. The strip north of USB1 shell pads and west of U1, so the regulator sits between the USB end and the bridge and off the USB pair path (run 26 measured the same strip). Widened after seed 1 measured a C3/U2 courtyard overlap of 2.5 mm2 inside the first 8.1 x 4.4 mm strip.

blocks.name: bridge
blocks.note: the SSOP-20 bridge, centre-west: its USB pair comes straight in from USB1 on the west, its UART leaves east toward CON1/CON2.

blocks.name: xtal
blocks.note: the oscillator loop Y1+C2+C4, on the north edge of the bridge zone next to U1 and away from the USB pair (which runs along y~100).

blocks.name: reset
blocks.note: the auto-reset pair with its base resistors, north-east of U1 and west of the east fiducial keepout (x 139.7).

blocks.name: series
blocks.note: series termination on U0TXD/U0RXD between U1 and CON1, at the driver end, on the path east (zone pulled 3.5 mm west after seed 0 measured R3 6.15 mm from U1 pad 15 against the 4 mm clause).

context.keepouts_note: 2 keep-out(s) DECLARED by the design brief board.design-brief.json. A keep-out is a mechanical fact and cannot be read off a board, so the emitter writes none; these came from the one channel that can state one. Since #701 the seat search honours them, not only the grade.
context.note: read-only, describing the board as it is. The outline is not editable by this toolchain: size, cutouts and slots are mechanical decisions the user owns
context.proximity_note: 11 proximity claim(s) DECLARED by the design brief board.design-brief.json. "These two named parts, this far apart" is a SPEC fact: the board supplies the distance but never the claim, so the emitter writes none and these came from the one channel that can state one. They are graded from the intent, not by any seat search, so a violation is a finding to act on rather than a pose the engine will refuse.
context.zone_plan: authored by hand for run 27 from the brief context; every movable part not must_lock and not a declared edge connector is in a zoned block. CON1 (east) and CON2 (south) are seeded on their declared edge bands.
